scripts.dev: bun run build && bunx wrangler dev --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.deploy: D1_GIGS=1 bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply scarletts-crew --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply scarletts-crew --local
